companyContext: Lidl is a German international discount supermarket chain operating over 10,000 stores in more than 30 countries across Europe and the USA. It is owned by the Schwarz Group and offers high-quality products at affordable prices, including a diverse range of private-label brands spanning food, household goods, fashion, and DIY tools.
brandContext: PARKSIDE is Lidl's own-brand range of tools, garden equipment, and accessories. Named the best-selling DIY brand in Europe by Euromonitor International in 2024, PARKSIDE offers reliable products for DIY beginners, enthusiasts, and professionals. The range covers workshop, home, and garden categories, including the X12V and X20V cordless battery systems, the PARKSIDE Performance high-power sub-line, and the eco-friendly Parkside Eco Line. In the spring and summer context, PARKSIDE focuses on garden tools such as lawnmowers, hedge trimmers, pressure washers, and cordless garden multi-tools, empowering seasonal DIYers to tackle outdoor projects with confidence.
productName: PARKSIDE Spring & Summer DIY Tools (Garden & Workshop Range)

typography.fontUses: Brand name / logotype. The PARKSIDE wordmark is set in a custom bold condensed uppercase sans-serif typeface, used exclusively for the brand name on packaging, marketing materials, and signage.
Headings and campaign slogans such as 'YOU GOT THIS!' Appears in bold or extra-bold weights for high-impact messaging on promotional banners, store displays, and digital ads.
Body copy on web pages, product descriptions, and marketing collateral. Clean, highly legible sans-serif used at regular weight for informational content on parkside-diy.com and Lidl sub-pages.
Sub-headings, product names, and calls to action. Semi-bold weight used for secondary emphasis in digital and print communications.

brandVision: PARKSIDE aims to democratise DIY by providing powerful, reliable, and constantly innovating tools at the best price-performance ratio, empowering everyone — from first-time DIYers to passionate home improvers — to take projects into their own hands. The brand is expanding into smart connected tools, eco-friendly product lines, and garden innovations to meet the evolving needs of consumers across Europe.
brandValues: Empowerment: 'You Got This!' — PARKSIDE believes the greatest success is doing it yourself. The brand stands for accessibility (quality tools at unbeatable prices), reliability (high-quality standards across all product lines), can-do attitude (inspiring determination, confidence, and action), sustainability (Eco Line products and giving things a second life through DIY), and innovation (constantly expanding with smart batteries, brushless motors, and connected tools). PARKSIDE champions the power of doing it yourself without compromise.
